T: If you build it, they will eat.
D: An Iowa farmer builds a baseball diamond in his cornfield after hearing a voice.
P: Serve the main when Ray plays catch with his dad.
S: the Iowa cornfield around the diamond
Sweet corn boiled and rolled in butter and salt, straight from the field Ray ploughs under.
Roasted peanuts in the shell and salted sunflower seeds, the classic snacks for watching baseball.
M: Buttermilk fried chicken with mashed potatoes, a Midwest farmhouse dinner. Soak 1.2kg chicken pieces in 300ml buttermilk for an hour.
W: Apple pie with vanilla ice cream. Slice 5 green apples, toss with 100g sugar and cinnamon.
K: a summer evening on the farm
Homemade lemonade over ice. Stir the juice of 6 lemons with 150g sugar until dissolved.

s.note: the Iowa cornfield around the diamond
s.how: Boil 4 corn cobs in salted water for 6 minutes. Roll in 40g butter, sprinkle with salt and cut each in half. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.
Tip 500g roasted peanuts in the shell into a big bowl and 200g salted sunflower seeds into a smaller one. Put out a third bowl for shells.

m.how: Soak 1.2kg chicken pieces in 300ml buttermilk for an hour. Dredge in 200g seasoned flour and fry at 170C for 14 minutes. Serve with mash from 800g potatoes.

w.how: Slice 5 green apples, toss with 100g sugar and cinnamon. Line a dish with 1 pastry sheet, fill, top with another and bake at 190C for 45 minutes. Serve with ice cream.

d.note: a summer evening on the farm
d.how: Stir the juice of 6 lemons with 150g sugar until dissolved. Top with 1.2L cold water and serve over ice. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
